newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bloomberg Television launches on SES's Astra.
newsitem.headline: Bloomberg Television launches on SES's Astra.

text.p: Societe Europeenne des Satellites SA (SES), the Luxembourg operator of the Astra system, said in a statement on Friday it had begun broadcasting signals for Bloomberg Television's English language service.
SES said the signals could be received by around six million homes in the U.K. and Ireland and more than 23 million homes in continental Europe.
"This expands our reach through the UK and Europe," Michael Bloomberg, chairman of parent company Bloomberg LP, said in the statement.
SES said Bloomberg Television's English service was also due to be part of BSkyB's digital package, due to be launched on Astra in the spring of 1998.
Bloomberg Television is already available on a number of cable television networks.
